auditor.independence: Auditor session b973c86b28e4 (task role, lopdev lane move-working-set, manager 35c4f00e8d73). Translator was a different session: agent coder, job eacba7a3806e, session 76c99189cb1d. Same served model family as the translator (anthropic/claude-opus-5-5), different agent and run; no fallback. No MT or translation API used.

findings.problem: push → 'publicar' and commit → 'confirmar' ('commits sin publicar', 'cambios sin confirmar', 'Publica o confirma lo que necesites antes de moverla', 'Publícalo', 'Publica o reescribe el commit'). es.md keeps commit/push English and its TUI-wave amendment says push/pull stay English because 'the user pairs the label with the subcommand they already type'; the corpus says 'hiciste push' / 'Push automático'. Worse, this is a consent dialog: the same dialog asks the user to 'vuelve a confirmar' (working_set_changed), and the es corpus uses 'sin confirmar' 25+ times for 'unconfirmed'. So 'cambios sin confirmar' reads 'unconfirmed changes' and the remedy 'Publica o confirma lo que necesites' reads 'publish or confirm what you need': the actionable git remedy (push / commit before moving) is lost in the very strings that warn files will not travel.
findings.fix: Keep the git verbs: 'commits sin push' (or 'commits sin hacer push'), 'cambios sin commit'; remedies 'Haz push o commit de lo que necesites antes de moverla', 'Haz push del commit o reescríbelo…', 'Haz push o clónalo en el otro dispositivo…', 'Haz push de los commits…', 'o cancelar y hacer push o commit de tu trabajo primero'.

findings.problem: 'Estoy seguro de que…' is masculine-only in a required first-person consent checkbox; the English is neutral and the es corpus's consent labels are neutral ('Entiendo que…', 'Confirmo que he leído…').
'vuelve a moverlo' (masculine 'lo' = the worktree) for 'then move again', while warning_leave says 'antes de moverla' (the conversation). What is moved again is the conversation.
findings.fix: '… y vuelve a intentar el movimiento' (or '… y vuelve a moverla').

findings.note: Mechanical checks on the committed bytes at dd014c1e9d (scratch script run with the repo's @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser): key set equals English; the base..head diff of this file is exactly the 42 added working_set_* lines (0 changed, 0 removed values, so every other value is the bytes audited by the superseded row); every audited value parses and carries the same arguments, types and ::group-off skeletons as English; plural arms present for every CLDR category of the locale and no foreign arm; NFC; no bidi controls (U+200E/F, U+202A-E, U+2066-9, U+061C); no ASCII '...'; no leading/trailing/double spaces; no <Trans> tags in this namespace.
